title: Didascalia: positive, free, particular, universal, catechetical, systematic
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss: that same stands as QUINTUS DIDASCALIA alligata textum interpretatur that same stands as belonging toward plus Theologia positiva interpretando scripturam that same stands as belonging toward plus which judgment stands as made libera particularis populariter scholastice that same stands as belonging toward plus toward this end universalis catechetica systematica that same stands as belonging toward plus as also called historica logica duplex that same stands as belonging toward plus claim gloss: the fifth is plus didascalia properly so as called which is stands either bound to from the text it that interprets whence positive which theology claim gloss: or it is plus free and particular as about a certain stands argument only popular from or scholastic claim gloss: or it is plus universal either catechetical as about things necessary stands to salvation or from full systematic about that things revealed from which heaven claim gloss: and this can plus be twofold historical as and logical
pass_b_english: The fifth is DIDASCALIA properly so called, which is either bound to the text it interprets — and from that text its order chiefly depends — whence it is called positive theology, because by interpreting Scripture it lays down the principles and foundations of theological dogmas;

or it is free, and that particular, about a certain argument only: if it is instituted popularly, it is fitted to the time, place, and capacity of the hearers; if by the rule of art or scholastically, it nearly follows the laws of treating a theme logically;
or it is universal, and that either compendious or catechetical about all or at least most things necessary to salvation, or full or systematic about all or most things revealed from heaven.
And this can be twofold: historical and logical.
source_text: QUINTUS est DIDASCALIA proprie sic dicta, quae est vel alligata ad textum, quem interpretatur: a quo propterea ordo ejus potissimum dependet. unde Theologia positiva dicitur, quippe quae, interpretando scripturam, principia & fundamenta dogmatum theologicorum ponit: vel est libera, eaque particularis, de certo duntaxat argumento, quae si populariter instituitur, tempori, loco & captui auditorum accommodatur: si ad artis regulam sive scholastice, thematis logice tractandi leges fere sequitur: vel universalis, eaque vel compendiosa sive catechetica de omnibus vel plerisque saltem necessariis ad salutem, vel plena sive systematica de omnibus aut plerisque revelatis divinitus. Atque haec duplex esse potest historica & logica.
